notes: Fixed the OG panel cutting off its own bottom and never recovering. The panel was not frozen - the clock and every sensor were live - but the window had stopped at a height measured hours earlier, so the microphone, Bluetooth/Wi-Fi, power…

The cause: the panel only re-measured its height when the NUMBER of items grew. Anything that got taller without adding an item was invisible to it - shortcut icons finishing their load and reflowing to three rows, the weather card gaining…

It now re-measures whenever the content height actually changes, which is the question it was really asking all along. Verified in the running app: a reflow that adds no items resizes the window, and undoing that reflow shrinks the window…
When a panel genuinely is taller than your screen, the app now records that instead of silently dropping the overflow, and says how many pixels cannot be shown.
